# Scene spec reference

Every field of a scene spec (`schema: loop.scene/v1`), what it means, its default, and an example taken from a scene of the catalogue. Nothing is written for a field at its default.

## The scene

| Field | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema` | `loop.scene/v1` | The version of the spec itself | `"loop.scene/v1"` |
| `id` (required) | text | Unique scene identifier | — |
| `version` | text | Scene version | `"0.0.1"` |
| `name` (required) | text | Display name: the tab's | — |
| `description` | text | What happens in it, in a sentence | empty |
| `tags` | list of text |  | — |
| `icon` | text | Icon identifier | `"people"` |
| `emoji` | text | Its face: one emoji, drawn before its name | `"👀"` |
| `team` | text | The team it stages, `id` or `id:version` | empty |
| `entry` | text | The member the audience talks to; the team's entry when unsaid | empty |
| `cast` | list of [SceneCastMember](#scenecastmember) | The cast: personas and briefs, or the members | — |
| `setting` | [SceneSetting](#scenesetting) | The stage | — |
| `script` | list of [SceneBeat](#scenebeat) | The beats, in order | — |
| `stage` | [SceneStage](#scenestage) | Directions for the page | — |
| `audience` | [SceneAudience](#sceneaudience) | Who may watch and ask | — |
| `rehearsal` | [SceneRehearsal](#scenerehearsal) | Its tests | — |
| `deployment` | [SceneDeployment](#scenedeployment) | Where it plays | — |

## Examples

Each from a scene of the catalogue, as its file writes it.

### `schema`

```yaml
schema: loop.scene/v1
```

### `id`

```yaml
id: crop-monitoring
```

### `version`

```yaml
version: 0.0.1
```

### `name`

```yaml
name: Crop Monitoring
```

### `description`

```yaml
description: One agent follows crop vigour and growth over a season from the satellite
  imagery NASA Earthdata holds, and flags the fields that need attention.
```

### `tags`

```yaml
tags:
- example
- scene
- earthdata
- agriculture
- a2a
```

### `icon`

```yaml
icon: globe
```

### `emoji`

```yaml
emoji: 🛰️
```

### `team`

```yaml
team: crop-monitoring:0.0.1
```

### `cast`

```yaml
cast:
- member: crop-monitoring
  persona:
    name: Crop Monitoring
    line: I search the imagery and tell you how the fields are doing.
  brief: Take the field and the period, search the datasets and the granules that
    cover them, and report the vigour, the growth and the fields to watch; leave any
    download to the person.
```

### `setting`

```yaml
setting:
  systems:
  - server: earthdata:0.0.1
    as: Earthdata
    holds: NASA's catalogue of satellite imagery, searched, not downloaded.
  period: the last three months
  language: en
  assumes: 'One agent, its data: Crop Monitoring on Datalayer, searching the satellite
    imagery NASA Earthdata holds.'
```

### `script`

```yaml
script:
- id: vigour-this-season
  cue:
    say: How has crop vigour evolved over the last three months around 45.5N, 10.2E?
  narration: The datasets that cover the place, then the granules of the season.
  moves:
  - who: crop-monitoring
    asks: earthdata
    over: mcp
    tool: search_earth_datasets
    does: read
    what: the vegetation datasets covering the place
  - who: crop-monitoring
    asks: earthdata
    over: mcp
    tool: search_earth_datagranules
    does: read
    what: the granules of the last three months
  - who: crop-monitoring
    answers: chart
    what: the vigour month by month
  - who: crop-monitoring
    answers: words
    what: how the season went, in a paragraph
  expect: A chart of the vigour month by month from the granules found, and a paragraph
    saying how the season went; nothing downloaded.
  shows:
  - chart
  - words
  branch:
  - decision: no granule covers the period
    expect: It says so, and names the nearest dates that are covered.
- id: fields-to-watch
  cue:
    say: Which fields around 41.9N, 12.5E show a drop in vegetation this month compared
      with last?
  narration: This month against the last, field by field.
  moves:
  - who: crop-monitoring
    asks: earthdata
    over: mcp
    tool: search_earth_datagranules
    does: read
    what: the granules of this month and the last
  - who: crop-monitoring
    answers: table
    what: the fields whose vegetation dropped, with the drop
  expect: A table of the fields whose vegetation dropped from last month to this,
    each with the size of the drop, from the imagery found.
  shows:
  - table
  pace: slow
- id: imagery-available
  cue:
    say: Which datasets and granules cover the Po valley for June 2026?
  narration: What there is to look at, before anything is looked at.
  moves:
  - who: crop-monitoring
    asks: earthdata
    over: mcp
    tool: search_earth_datasets
    does: read
    what: the datasets covering the Po valley
  - who: crop-monitoring
    asks: earthdata
    over: mcp
    tool: search_earth_datagranules
    does: read
    what: the granules of June 2026
  - who: crop-monitoring
    answers: sources
    what: the datasets and the granules as cards that open their pages
  expect: The datasets and the granules that cover the Po valley in June 2026 as cards,
    each with its date and a link that opens it at NASA Earthdata; a download is left
    to the person.
  shows:
  - sources
- id: save-granules
  cue:
    say: Save the June 2026 granules of the Po valley to my Space.
  narration: A download and a save — asked first, and not done for a visitor.
  moves:
  - who: crop-monitoring
    asks: earthdata
    over: mcp
    tool: search_earth_datagranules
    does: read
    what: the granules of June 2026
  - who: crop-monitoring
    answers: approval
    what: the granules it would save, as a choice to approve
  expect: 'It names the granules it would save and asks first — Save them · Not now
    — and saves nothing; a visitor who approves is refused in a sentence: without
    an account it only reads.'
  shows:
  - approval
```

### `stage`

```yaml
stage:
  positions:
    crop-monitoring:
      x: 0.5
      y: 0.5
  opens_first: crop-monitoring
  transcript:
    tools: true
    narration: true
  inspectors:
  - agent
  - tools
  rests_after: 10m
  pace: steady
```

### `audience`

```yaml
audience:
  who: visitors
  ceiling_per_ask: 0.05
  asks_a_day: 5
```

### `rehearsal`

```yaml
rehearsal:
  within: 10m
  beats:
  - beat: vigour-this-season
    lines:
    - You → Crop Monitoring
    - 'Crop Monitoring → Earthdata: search_earth_datasets'
    - 'Crop Monitoring → Earthdata: search_earth_datagranules'
    - 'Crop Monitoring: a chart'
    must_say:
    - vigour
    must_not_say:
    - I downloaded
    - I have downloaded
    - downloaded them
    within: 120s
  - beat: fields-to-watch
    lines:
    - You → Crop Monitoring
    - 'Crop Monitoring → Earthdata: search_earth_datagranules'
    - 'Crop Monitoring: a table'
    must_say:
    - drop
    within: 120s
  - beat: imagery-available
    lines:
    - You → Crop Monitoring
    - 'Crop Monitoring → Earthdata: search_earth_*'
    - 'Crop Monitoring: sources'
    must_say:
    - granule
    must_not_say:
    - I downloaded
    - I have downloaded
    - downloaded them
    within: 120s
  - beat: save-granules
    lines:
    - You → Crop Monitoring
    - 'Crop Monitoring → Earthdata: search_earth_datagranules'
    - 'Crop Monitoring: an approval'
    must_say:
    - granule
    must_not_say:
    - I downloaded
    - I have downloaded
    - downloaded them
    - saved them
    within: 120s
  verified:
    live: []
    recorded: []
    unverified:
    - Its runtime is not deployed under the demo account yet, and the rehearsal has
      not been played (A-14).
```

### `deployment`

```yaml
deployment:
  account: demo
  page: /
  addresses:
    crop-monitoring: DATALAYER_DEMO_SCENE_CROP_MONITORING_CROP_MONITORING_A2A_URL
```

### `entry`

```yaml
entry: sales
```

## Parts

### AppVerified

What was verified, and how, each in a sentence a person reads (LOOP E-14). An example says it on its card and on its page: what was tried live, what runs on recorded data instead, and what is not verified yet. Said by whoever tried it; nothing here is computed.

| Field | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `live` | list of text | What was tried live, where and when | — |
| `recorded` | list of text | What runs on recorded data, not on live calls | — |
| `unverified` | list of text | What is not verified yet | — |

### RehearsalBeat

What a beat's transcript must look like.

| Field | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `beat` (required) | text | The beat, by id | — |
| `lines` | list of text | The shape, in order: `Sales → Accounting`, `Accounting → Odoo: odoo_accounting_*`, `Accounting: a table` | — |
| `must_say` | list of text | Words that must appear | — |
| `must_not_say` | list of text | Words that must not | — |
| `within` | text | The time the beat may take | empty |

### SceneAudience

Who may watch and ask, and what an ask may cost.

| Field | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `who` | [Watchers](#watchers) | `visitors`, `signed-in`, or `nobody` | `"signed-in"` |
| `ceiling_per_ask` | number | What one ask may cost, in USD; the site's when 0 | `0` |
| `asks_a_day` | integer | How many asks a visitor gets a day; the site's when 0 | `0` |

### SceneBeat

One beat of the script.

| Field | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` (required) | text | Its id: what the rehearsal and a branch name | — |
| `cue` (required) | [SceneCue](#scenecue) | What starts it | — |
| `narration` | text | One line for the audience, read in the transcript | empty |
| `moves` | list of [SceneMove](#scenemove) | Who asks whom over what, in order | — |
| `expect` (required) | text | What should happen, in words | — |
| `shows` | list of [AnswerKind](#answerkind) | What the page shows: the answers to the audience when unsaid | — |
| `pace` | [Pace](#pace) | Its pace; the stage's when unsaid | empty |
| `branch` | list of [SceneBranch](#scenebranch) | What it does instead, on a decision | — |

### SceneBranch

What a beat does instead when a decision holds.

| Field | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `decision` (required) | text | When, in words: *the books hold no open invoice* | — |
| `expect` | text | What happens then, in words | empty |
| `moves` | list of [SceneMove](#scenemove) | The moves then, when they differ | — |
| `then` | text | The beat that follows, by id, when the script goes on elsewhere | empty |

### SceneCastMember

A member of the cast. On a staged team, it names a member of the team (`member`) and says only how it appears here (`persona`) and what it is for in this scene (`brief`). Written inline — a scene with no `team` — it is the member: what it is (`app`, `ref` or `server`), its `role`, where it `runs_in` and whom it `talks_to`, as a team member says them.

| Field | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `member` (required) | text | Its id: in the team, or in this cast | — |
| `app` | text | Inline: the application it is, `id` or `id:version` | empty |
| `ref` | text | Inline: the agent it is, `id` or `id:version` | empty |
| `server` | text | Inline: the MCP server it is, a system of the scene | empty |
| `role` | [TeamRole](#teamrole) | Inline: what it is for, structurally | empty |
| `runs_in` | [TeamPlace](#teamplace) | Inline: `browser` or `runtime` | empty |
| `talks_to` | list of [TeamLink](#teamlink) | Inline: whom it asks, and over what | — |
| `persona` | [ScenePersona](#scenepersona) | How it appears on stage | — |
| `brief` | text | What it is for in this scene, over its application's instructions | empty |

### SceneCue

What starts a beat: something the audience says, a schedule, or an event.

| Field | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `say` | text | An opener the audience may say: the entry's suggestion on the page | empty |
| `schedule` | text | A schedule, when the beat starts by itself | empty |
| `event` | text | An event, when something happening starts it | empty |

### SceneDeployment

Where the scene plays.

| Field | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account` | text | Under which account the scene plays: `demo` | empty |
| `page` | text | The page it plays on: the entry's address | empty |
| `addresses` | mapping of text | For each member on a runtime, the variable its address is read from at build | — |

### SceneMove

One member asking another over a protocol, or answering the audience.

| Field | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `who` (required) | text | The member moving, by its id in the cast | — |
| `asks` | text | Whom: a member or a system; nobody when it answers the audience | empty |
| `over` | [TeamProtocol](#teamprotocol) | `a2a` to a member, `mcp` to a system | empty |
| `what` | text | What it asks for, or what it answers, in words | empty |
| `tool` | text | Over `mcp`: the tool, by name or pattern (`odoo_accounting_*`) | empty |
| `does` | [ActionClass](#actionclass) | The kind of tool: `read`, `write`, … | empty |
| `answers` | [AnswerKind](#answerkind) | What kind of answer comes back | empty |

### ScenePersona

How a member appears to the audience, in this scene.

| Field | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | text | The name the audience sees; its application's when unsaid | empty |
| `face` | text | One emoji; its application's when unsaid | empty |
| `line` | text | One line of *who I am here* | empty |

### SceneRecording

A transcript recorded once, played when the scene cannot play live (LOOP H-08).

| Field | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` (required) | text | Its file, beside the scenes: `sales-and-accounting/recording.json` | — |
| `taken` | text | When it was recorded | empty |
| `note` | text | What the audience is told: *recorded on 2026-10-07* | empty |

### SceneRehearsal

The scene's tests: a passing rehearsal is the gallery's *Live*.

| Field | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `beats` | list of [RehearsalBeat](#rehearsalbeat) | Each beat's expected shape | — |
| `within` | text | The time the whole scene may take | empty |
| `recording` | [SceneRecording](#scenerecording) | A recording, for when it cannot play live | empty |
| `verified` | [AppVerified](#appverified) | What was verified live, what runs on recorded data, and what is not verified yet | — |

### SceneSetting

The stage: what is on it, and what the audience is told.

| Field | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `systems` | list of [SceneSystem](#scenesystem) | The systems the cast reaches | — |
| `frames` | list of text | The Frames the scene plays under, over the team's | — |
| `contents` | list of text | The data in play: documents and datasets | — |
| `period` | text | When the scene plays, in words: *March 2026* | empty |
| `language` | text | The language it plays in, `en` | empty |
| `assumes` | text | What the audience is told before it starts, one line | empty |

### SceneStage

Directions for the page.

| Field | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `positions` | mapping of [StagePosition](#stageposition) | Where each member stands | — |
| `opens_first` | text | Whose balloon opens first; the entry's when unsaid | empty |
| `transcript` | [SceneTranscript](#scenetranscript) | What the transcript shows | — |
| `inspectors` | list of [Inspector](#inspector) | The inspectors offered | — |
| `rests_after` | text | How long the scene plays before it rests | empty |
| `pace` | [Pace](#pace) | The pace of the beats that say none | `"steady"` |

### SceneSystem

A system on stage: an MCP server of the catalogue the cast reaches.

| Field | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `server` (required) | text | An MCP server of the catalogue, `id` or `id:version` | — |
| `as` | text | The name the audience reads on the graph and in the transcript | empty |
| `holds` | text | What it holds in this scene: *Datalayer's own books, March 2026* | empty |

### SceneTranscript

What the transcript shows.

| Field | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tools` | true or false | Whether tool lines are shown | `true` |
| `narration` | true or false | Whether the beats' narration is read in it | `true` |
| `withhold` | list of [Withheld](#withheld) | Words withheld: credentials, ids, … | — |

### StagePosition

Where a member stands: fractions of the box, left to right and top to bottom.

| Field | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x` (required) | number |  | — |
| `y` (required) | number |  | — |

### TeamLink

One member asking another, directly, over a protocol. Distinct from `depends_on`, which orders work: a link says who may ask whom while the work runs, in either order and as often as it needs.

| Field | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `member` (required) | text | The member asked, by its id in this team | — |
| `over` | [TeamProtocol](#teamprotocol) | The protocol it is asked over: `a2a` to an agent or an application, `mcp` to a server | `"a2a"` |

## Choices

| Name | Values |
| --- | --- |
| <a id="actionclass"></a>ActionClass | `read`, `write`, `send`, `buy`, `delete`, `publish` |
| <a id="answerkind"></a>AnswerKind | `words`, `table`, `chart`, `notebook`, `map`, `file`, `image`, `sources`, `choice`, `approval` |
| <a id="inspector"></a>Inspector | `agent`, `tools`, `a2a`, `notebook`, `cost` |
| <a id="pace"></a>Pace | `quick`, `steady`, `slow` |
| <a id="teamplace"></a>TeamPlace | `browser`, `runtime` |
| <a id="teamprotocol"></a>TeamProtocol | `a2a`, `mcp` |
| <a id="teamrole"></a>TeamRole | `coordinator`, `initiator`, `contributor`, `reviewer`, `finalizer` |
| <a id="watchers"></a>Watchers | `visitors`, `signed-in`, `nobody` |
| <a id="withheld"></a>Withheld | `credentials`, `ids`, `addresses`, `amounts` |
